class.name: VECSSystem
class.brief_description:
Base class for ECS systems, ticked by the scheduler.
ECS 系统的基类，由调度器驱动。
class.description:
[b]VECSSystem[/b] is the base class for game logic that runs over the ECS world. Register an instance with [method VECSWorld.add_system] and tick its group with [method VECSWorld.process].
Two authoring styles coexist: - [b]GDScript systems[/b] override [method _script_process] and reach the world through [method get_world_node] using the script API. - [b]C++ systems[/b] (compiled into the extension) override the C++ virtuals [code]_setup[/code], [code]_tick[/code] and [code]_deps[/code] for zero-Variant hot paths.
The scheduler respects [member group], [member active], [member paused], [member tick_interval] and [member flush_mode].
[b]VECSSystem[/b] 是在 ECS 世界上运行的游戏逻辑基类。用 [method VECSWorld.add_system] 注册实例，用 [method VECSWorld.process] 驱动其分组。
两种编写风格共存： - [b]GDScript 系统[/b]覆写 [method _script_process]，通过 [method get_world_node] 用脚本 API 访问世界。 - [b]C++ 系统[/b]（编译进扩展）覆写 C++ 虚方法 [code]_setup[/code]、[code]_tick[/code] 与 [code]_deps[/code]，实现零 Variant 热路径。
调度器会遵循 [member group]、[member active]、[member paused]、[member tick_interval] 与 [member flush_mode]。

method.name: _script_process
method.description:
GDScript override point, called when the system ticks. [param delta] is the time step in seconds. Reach the world via [method get_world_node].
GDScript 覆写点，系统被驱动时调用。[param delta] 是以秒为单位的时间步。通过 [method get_world_node] 访问世界。

method.name: get_system_name
method.description:
Returns the system's name (the node name).
返回系统名称（节点名）。

method.name: get_world_node
method.description:
Returns the owning [VECSWorld] node (may be null for C++-only systems that never needed it).
返回所属的 [VECSWorld] 节点（纯 C++ 且从未需要它的系统可能为 null）。

method.name: handle
method.description:
Scheduler entry point: dispatches to the script override [method _script_process] or the C++ [code]_tick[/code] virtual. Called automatically by the scheduler; you normally do not call it directly.
调度器入口：分派到脚本覆写 [method _script_process] 或 C++ 虚方法 [code]_tick[/code]。由调度器自动调用，通常无需直接调用。

method.name: set_world_node
method.description:
Injects the owning [VECSWorld] node. Called by the scheduler when the system is registered.
注入所属的 [VECSWorld] 节点。系统注册时由调度器调用。

members.member:
If [code]false[/code], the scheduler skips this system entirely.
若为 [code]false[/code]，调度器将完全跳过该系统。

Controls when the deferred command buffer is flushed: [constant PER_SYSTEM] after every system, [constant PER_GROUP] once per group, or [constant MANUAL] only when you call it yourself.
控制延迟命令缓冲何时冲刷：[constant PER_SYSTEM] 每个系统之后、[constant PER_GROUP] 每组一次、或 [constant MANUAL] 仅在你自行调用时。

The group this system belongs to; it only ticks when [method VECSWorld.process] is called with the same group name.
该系统所属的分组；只有当 [method VECSWorld.process] 以相同分组名被调用时它才会被驱动。

If [code]true[/code], the system is skipped while still remaining registered.
若为 [code]true[/code]，系统被跳过但仍保持注册状态。

Minimum time (seconds) between two ticks; [code]0.0[/code] ticks every frame. Useful for throttling low-priority systems.
两次驱动之间的最小间隔（秒）；[code]0.0[/code] 表示每帧驱动。适合节流低优先级系统。

constants.constant:
Flush the command buffer after this system runs.
在该系统运行后冲刷命令缓冲。

Flush the command buffer once after the whole group runs.
在整个分组运行后冲刷一次命令缓冲。

Never auto-flush; the user flushes via [method VECSCommandBuffer.flush].
从不自动冲刷；由用户通过 [method VECSCommandBuffer.flush] 冲刷。
